hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT RAM kernel FIT with CO5300 diagnostics and SPI idle-high initialization
Static FFS RAM root with LVGL

scenario: Boot the optional SC101IOT RAM kernel with the existing static root, read CO5300 status registers, inspect the SPI controller state, start LVGL and observe the optional camera sensor attachments.
expected: The CO5300 status reads identify the controller, LVGL renders a visible interface, and the optional sensor probe reads its expected ID while leaving the sensor parked.
observed: CO5300 ID, power, format and brightness reads returned 0xff bytes without reported bus errors. The SPI control register was 0x003c0000. Framebuffer rows changed from 480 to 960 with errors=0; LVGL remained alive. The operator confirmed the screen was completely black. The SC101IOT probe failed with ENXIO while acquiring its GPIO controls, before reading the sensor ID. An OV3640 node also attached at address 0x3c and failed XCLK lookup after claiming GPIO controls.
limits: One assembled V1.2 sample and a short RAM trial; this run did not write NOR. The restored EmberBSD NOR ranges had been independently verified before the RAM test.
All-0xff controller read values, SPI completion and framebuffer row counters do not establish valid panel identity, panel acknowledgement, physical bus timing or visible output.
The SC101IOT probe did not acquire its GPIO controls and did not read a sensor ID; this trial does not identify or reject the fitted sensor. DVP frame capture is not implemented by this driver.
The unexpected OV3640 attachment and XCLK failure do not identify the sensor. The OV3640-specific probe is not evidence of SC101IOT operation.
This trial did not repeat the separate touch-input check or establish calibration, audio, frame capture or Wi-Fi operation.
The UART log and device identifiers remain private.
